content.text:
I made a second round of fixes. I still haven't reproduced the problem or run a meeting, so I can't confirm it's fixed. After the first round I checked the code after the model replies (saving, loading and display) and none of it removes items. So the cause has to be in what the model is asked for or what it sees, and I found two more gaps there.

**1. Some modes only listed your own tasks.** In Sales, Recruiting and Team Meet, the "Action Items" section was defined as "action items that I have to do". So "Priya will send the contract" was left out because Priya isn't you. My first fix didn't cover this. Changes:
- `electron/services/ModesManager.ts`: those three section descriptions now ask for every task, with the person's name in front and the date if one was given.
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: the mode recap prompt now says to list every task that has a person on it, whoever that person is, with or without a date. This part matters because modes you already created keep their own saved copy of the old descriptions, so the template change alone won't reach them.

**2. Long meetings were cut off.** The model only saw the first 10,000 characters of the transcript, about 10–15 minutes of talk. Tasks mentioned after that never reached it. I raised the limit to 48,000 characters, which is still well within what Groq and Gemini can take.

If it still drops tasks, please tell me:
- which mode was active
- which AI provider you use
- the transcript line that got missed

Then check the app log for the line `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`. It shows whether the model never returned the task or something went wrong after that.
